proved: The corresponding six-coordinate remote center is an exact irrational nonzero null-cone center.
Every nonempty remote-choice subset has three-bank center norm at least 1/2.
For every R>=12 and 0<eta<1, (1-eta)^4 p_* <= p_Q(0) <= (1-eta)^4 p_* + 252 sqrt(6)/R.
For every R>=3600 the explicit family satisfies p_Q(0)<3sqrt2, uniformly in eta.
Any fixed finite collection of non-kernel remote rectangular cells has O(1/R) cone-tip contribution in this exact matrix geometry, even if a leading center lies exactly on the real null cone.
